title: LineKeyLabelSelection
description:
* `PERSON_EXTENSION` - This will display the person extension, or if a person doesn't have an extension, the person's first name will be displayed.
 * `PERSON_FIRST_THEN_LAST_NAME` - Indicates that devices will display the name in first name then last name format.
 * `PERSON_LAST_THEN_FIRST_NAME` - Indicates that devices will display the name in last name then first name format.
